name: android-agent-kit
description: Android development MCP server: Gradle, adb, logcat, lint, crash triage, Perfetto, emulator control.
long_description: Gives an AI coding agent real Android tools through a local, permissioned MCP server instead of raw shell access. Inspect Gradle projects, run allowlisted build tasks, capture logcat and screenshots, triage crashes (de-obfuscating release traces with an R8 mapping), analyze APK size, and — behind explicit capability grants — drive an emulator or device. Everything runs locally, command output is redacted, and grants live only in a user policy the agent cannot modify.
